request.prompt:
日常随行航拍。设计一台便于日常携带的航拍四旋翼。
四个电机各装一副静止、完全展开的双叶螺旋桨，每个电机只装两片桨叶。
目标部位：航拍相机舱与机身，四处臂根与机身。
本次改变：保持紧凑，让相机舱与主壳、机臂与机身的接合边界容易辨认。
保持：机头朝画面上沿。机载相机朝画面上沿的地平线平视拍摄。制图者从飞机正上方看见相机外壳的顶面，前向镜面在这个视角接近一条边。机身冷灰色。
自由项：舱体安装、机身轮廓、臂根曲面和分件。
Propulsion: 5-inch 2-blade propellers; motor tilt 0°.
4 个电机，True X 布局。最大电机中心距设计值 250 mm，相邻夹角从 R1 起顺时针为 90、90、90、90°。
随附正交俯视定位图，机头朝上，红点定位电机轴心。蓝线表示机架连接。
输出正交俯视产品图，制图观察方向从无人机正上方垂直向下，机头指向画面上沿，完整显示所有电机轴心和桨叶。保持各轴心在定位图画幅内的归一化位置和留白。
浅色中性背景，照片级工业产品设计渲染，柔和棚拍侧光与接触阴影，画面无辅助线、刻度或文字。

configurator_design_fields.instruction:
探索适合日常携带的整机方案。
保留四个电机轴心、相连的机臂和前向相机。
机身外轮廓、相机安装位置与接合方式、机臂过渡、壳体曲面和分件可探索。

provider_revised_prompt: The spatial layout and normalized positioning of the four red motor-axis dots, the intersecting blue frame lines, and the central upward-pointing white arrow in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The target image is a photorealistic top-down orthographic industrial design render of a compact everyday-carry quadcopter drone with a cool-gray fuselage and four stationary fully deployed two-blade propellers, positioned according to <Subject 1> against a light neutral studio background. <Subject 1> supplies the exact X-configuration geometry, normalized motor-center spacing, and upward nose orientation transferred to the drone's motors, arms, and forward heading, while the schematic graphic marks themselves are replaced by the physical aircraft. Viewed vertically from directly above with the nose pointing toward the top edge of the canvas, the drone features a compact cool-gray main shell with crisp, easily recognizable parting seams where the four cylindrical arm roots blend into the central body via smooth fillets. At each of the four motor positions defined by <Subject 1>, an upright zero-degree-tilt brushless motor sits at the tip of a sleek carbon-fiber-textured or matte gray arm, topped with a stationary, fully unfolded 5-inch two-blade propeller consisting of exactly two symmetrical dark-gray blades per rotor. Beneath the front of the fuselage, a compact gimbal camera pod is mounted so that its lens points horizontally toward the top edge of the frame; from this vertical overhead viewpoint, only the rounded top housing of the camera pod is visible, with its forward-facing transparent lens plane foreshortened into a thin leading edge aligned with the nose direction. Soft studio side lighting models the matte and satin cool-gray surfaces, casting gentle gradients across the fuselage contours, subtle highlights along the arm-root junctions and propeller blades, and soft contact shadows onto the clean, unadorned light neutral surface below, with no auxiliary lines, scales, or text present.
